meta.name: dynamic-pricing-ecommerce
meta.description: Design a controlled dynamic-pricing or repricing system for ecommerce products. Use when a seller asks for demand-based, inventory-based, competitor-responsive, or time-based price rules; SKU eligibility; price floors and ceilings; automation approvals; simulations; monitoring; or rollback plans across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, eBay, or other channels. Do not use for a one-time optimal-price calculation or to change live prices without explicit authorization.

copy.tagline: 根据需求、库存和竞争实时调整产品定价
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果管理多平台店铺，需要自动化定价规则和监控回滚
copy.tagline_en: Automatically adjust product prices based on demand, inventory, and competition
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run multi-channel ecommerce and need automated dynamic pricing with monitoring and rollback

howto.what: 装上后，当你提出动态定价需求时，Claude 会设计一套受控的定价系统，包括定义SKU资格、计算安全价格上下限、选择信号、创建规则矩阵、模拟不同场景、设计审批与回滚机制，并输出实施计划。它不会直接更改真实价格。
howto.when: 当卖家提出需要基于需求、库存、竞争对手或时间等条件来调整价格；或需要SKU资格分类、价格上限/下限、自动化审批、模拟、监控、回滚计划时，该技能会被触发。

say.text: 为这200个SKU设计安全的亚马逊调价规则，避免价格战。
say.note: Claude会生成规则矩阵和模拟结果。

say.text: 为我的Shopify店铺创建关注库存的动态定价方案。
say.note: Claude会输出分阶段实施计划。

howto.what_en: When installed, on dynamic pricing requests, Claude will design a controlled repricing system: define SKU eligibility, calculate safe price floors/ceilings, select signals, build rule matrices, simulate scenarios, and design approval/rollback controls. It does not change live prices.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a seller asks for demand-based, inventory-based, competitor-responsive, or time-based price rules; SKU eligibility; price floors/ceilings; automation approvals; simulations; monitoring; or rollback plans across channels.

say_en.text: Design safe Amazon repricing rules for these 200 SKUs without starting a price war.
say_en.note: Claude will produce rule matrices and simulation results.

say_en.text: Create an inventory-aware dynamic pricing plan for my Shopify store.
say_en.note: Claude will output a staged rollout plan.
